- Rosiglitazone: 2,593 / 67,593 ≈ 3.84%
- Pioglitazone: 5,386 / 159,978 ≈ 3.37%

Pioglitazone has more cases only because it has more patients. Its rate is actually lower than rosiglitazone's, so the conclusion is wrong as well as the reasoning.
